condition_setup: Prompt-only allowed/prohibited comparison in a shared neutral VS Code workspace; the Skill is not physically absent.

condition_prompts.a: Do not use the adversarial-thinking skill. Do not invoke it or read its SKILL.md or supporting files. Complete the task using your normal workflow.
condition_prompts.b: You may use the adversarial-thinking skill if applicable. Complete the task using your normal workflow.

limitations: 4 pairs are diagnostic, not statistical uplift
Prompt prohibition is not physical absence; global metadata may be exposed.
Only one allowed session loaded the Skill; others are not loaded-versus-unloaded comparisons.
Other global workflows and prompt wording confound attribution.
No raw reasoning, credentials, controller gold, or provider response body is included.
Displayed rounded costs do not prove actual billing or Coding Plan quota usage.
Visible task submissions count sessions, not exact provider HTTP requests.
Smallest-next-action score is a manual assessment, separate from verdict correctness.
Prompt requested <=220 words; exact word counts were not audited.
